title: Expert Evaluation of LLM's Open-Ended Legal Reasoning on the Japanese Bar Exam Writing Task

prompt.location: Sec 4.1: persona described ("Japanese legal expert", casual Japanese) plus quoted instruction "Answer based on laws and regulations in force as of [the date of the examination]"
prompt.note: Bar-exam question wording is the official test item, not a constructed prompt component.

claim.location: Table 1, row o3 ZS, Avg. column; n = 21 questions (7 per year, 2021-2023), Sec 4.3

data.source: Japanese bar exam questions 2021-2023 (official published exam, 7 compulsory subjects)

notes: Expert grading by 7 legal-faculty evaluators (human judge). FS and FS+Law settings for o3 give Avg=29.4 and 30.5. GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-11-20, off the live list) and Claude 3 Opus are run for comparison; reproduction also requires recruiting equivalent legal-expert graders, not just API calls.
